answer: Census over 445 product files and 317 test files found 2290 default parameters: 1106 exercised (at least one test omits the argument), 258 unexercised (tests call the function but always pass the argument), 903 with no matching test calls, 23 unresolved. The planted DEFAULT_MIN_BYTES replica at command-center/p2-wave/probes/TST-0339/fixtures/estate/product.py:16 is unexercised (supplying_calls=3, omitting_calls=0). Mutating it 1024->512 keeps the suite green; mutating the exercised scale_by_factor default 2->99 turns the suite red. DEFAULT_MIN_BYTES is absent from this worktree's tools/; the replica reconstructs the measured hole. SUCCESS:TST-0339
